name: Burn
description: Damage at the end of each valid round. Bypasses armor and shields. Reapplying refreshes duration; potency uses the higher value, never adds.

name: Poison
description: Damage at the end of each valid round. Bypasses armor and shields. Reapplying refreshes duration; potency uses the higher value, never adds.

name: Stun
description: Skips the affected enemy counteraction this round, then expires. Cooldowns prevent consecutive stun locks.

name: Shield
description: Absorbs direct hits until capacity is exhausted or two rounds pass. Damage over time bypasses it. No additive stacking.
